items.title: 31.3 X-ray crystallography aur banawat ka tajziya (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of X-ray crystallography (PDF 223-224).

blocks.text: X-ray crystallography aik bohat taqatwar tajziyati auzaar hai jo qalmi (crystalline) thos mein atoms ki teen-jehti (three-dimensional) jagahein pehchanta hai. Yeh materials science, biochemistry aur dawa-sazi ki chemistry mein ahem hai kyunke is se scientists materials ki banawat dekh sakte hain. X-rays ki wavelength bohat chhoti hai, is liye yeh shuaein molecule ya ionic compound mein electrons aur atoms ki jagahein maloom karne mein use hoti hain. Thos materials atoms ki tahon ya lariyon (strands) par mushtamil hote hain.
Jab source se X-rays crystal par parti hain to atoms se takra kar khaas zawiyon par diffract hoti hain (Figure 31.4).

blocks.alt: Do mutawazi aane wali X-rays (teer) surkh atoms ki qataaron mein aik doosre ke oopar neeche, d faasle par, do atoms se takrati hain aur qataaron se usi zawiye theta par diffracted X-rays ban kar nikalti hain. Oopar wale atom se gulabi amood neeche wali ray par atom se pehle aur baad d sin theta kaat'te hain; oopar wale atom par theta aur neeche wale par 2 theta. Diffracted rays ke saath gulabi bracket par '2d sin theta = total path length difference'.
blocks.caption: Figure 31.4: X-ray diffraction (kitab ki Figure 31.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 31.4 mein daen taraf 'Different X-rays' chhapa hai; sahi lafz 'Diffracted X-rays' hai, kyunke kitab ka apna matan kehta hai ke X-rays atoms se takra kar diffract hoti hain. Neeche wali tah se lautne wali ray ko oopar wali ray se 'd sin theta' aate hue aur 'd sin theta' jaate hue zyada rasta tay karna parta hai, yani kul izafi rasta 2d sin theta. Jab yeh izafi rasta wavelength ka poora guna ho to rays aik doosre ko mazboot karti hain aur screen par roshan nuqta banta hai.

Diffract shuda shuaein screen par naqsh banati hain jinhein diffraction patterns kehte hain. Diffraction pattern molecule mein atoms aur electrons ki jagah batata hai; is se naqshe bante aur atoms ke darmiyan faasle maloom hote hain. Riyazi models se pattern ka tajziya kar ke scientists crystal mein atoms ki jagahon aur bond angles ka mufassal naqsha banate hain, yun atoms aur un ki electron density ka poora naqsha bana kar molecule ya crystal ki mukammal banawat maloom hoti hai. Figure 31.5 naphthalene ke liye yeh dikhati hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: naphthalene ka electron-density contour naqsha: mota bahari contour jis mein hydrogen atoms ki jagah ubhaar hain, rings ke beech do chhe-kone khali hisse, aur das carbon atoms par tah-dar gol contours; leader lines 500 (andar aur bahar), 1000 aur 2000 dikhati hain. Daen: naphthalene ki banawat, do jure chhe-rukni rings (andar daire), das C aur aath H atoms.
blocks.caption: Figure 31.5: Naphthalene molecule ka diffraction pattern (kitab ki Figure 31.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baen naqsha batata hai ke molecule mein electrons kahan zyada hain: har gol tah-dar nishan aik carbon atom hai (beech mein sab se ghana, 2000 se zyada), aur bahari ubhaar hydrogen atoms hain jin ke paas electrons kam hain (sirf 500 wala contour). Rings ke beech khali hisse mein electron density kam hai. Is naqshe se atoms ki jagahein naap kar daen wali banawat banayi jati hai.

X-ray diffraction (XRD) ka sab se mashhoor istemal DNA ki double helix banawat maloom karna hai. Yeh ab bhi enzymes aur proteins jaise pecheeda hayatiyati molecules ke tajziye mein use hota hai. Dawa sazi mein designers is se dekhte hain ke dawa ka molecule apne hadaf se kaise jurta hai. Yeh minerals, masnoi crystals aur nanomaterials ke tajziye mein bhi use hota hai, jis se electronics, optics aur tameerat mein materials ki karkardagi behtar hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Crystal mein atoms ki jagahein maloom karne ke liye X-rays kyun use hoti hain, nazar aane wali roshni kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation: X-rays ki wavelength bohat chhoti, atoms ke darmiyani faaslon jitni hai, is liye atoms ki tahein inhein diffract karti hain; nazar aane wali roshni ki wavelength bohat lambi hai.

blocks.prompt: X-ray crystallography ke do istemal batayein.
blocks.explanation: In mein se koi do: DNA ki double helix banawat maloom karna; enzymes aur proteins ka mutala; dawa sazi; minerals, masnoi crystals aur nanomaterials ka tajziya.

items: XRD crystals mein atoms ki 3D jagahein maloom karta.
Izafi rasta 2d sin(theta); diffraction patterns se electron-density naqshe.
